title: cyanus lanigerus
intro: Cyanus lanigerus, commonly known as woolly meadow goat's-beard, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include supporting digestive health, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyanus lanigerus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating various conditions such as skin irritations, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
